verdicts.factCheck: Fetched the v0.16.7 sources. cmd/monad/main.cpp declares trace_calls at line 146, registers --trace-calls at line 214, and at line 488 builds vm::VM vm{trace_calls ? vm::VM::InterpreterOnly : vm::VM::Dual} under a comment (lines 485-487) that the compiler does not expose the error exit codes call traces need; trace_calls is passed on at lines 512, 525, 543 and 559. runloop_monad.cpp lines 233-245 make a CallTracer only when enable_tracing is set and lines 330-337 commit call_frames with the receipts. monad_executor.cpp line 1309 declares vm_ as InterpreterOnly with a comment that the compiler misreports out of gas, and vm_ is used at 1525, 1547, 1824 and 1969. monad-bft debug.rs lines 381-388 map status 0, 2, 3 and 18 and send every other status to "error"; debug_replay.rs lines 61-63 send only the prestate tracer to replay. interpreter/stack.hpp lines 40-45 exit with OutOfGas on a static gas shortfall. On chain at https://rpc.monad.xyz on 2026-11-24: web3_clientVersion returned Monad/0.16.7; debug_traceTransaction callTracer on 0x90dad9c6...ad77 returned stored frames with a PoolManager swap frame (selector 0xf3cd914c, gas 94,784) marked "out of gas", as oogscan.json lists; the finalized block was 125,132,202. oogscan.json also holds 2 frames marked "error" among the failed transactions; the finding does not claim these are out-of-gas frames, and the interpreter also writes generic error codes for other faults, so they do not contradict it. The out-of-gas observation is consistent with interpreter output; the source code is what proves the tracing node interprets. The state root agreement with validators was not independently tested here beyond the node serving finalized blocks.
verdicts.codeCheck: The untaken branches the finding names exist as described. src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:42-49 takes the mulDivRoundingUp path only when amount * sqrtPX96 does not overflow and the denominator does not wrap, and :52 is the divRoundingUp fallback otherwise. src/libraries/SqrtPriceMath.sol:94-98 and :103-106 switch to FullMath.mulDiv and mulDivRoundingUp only when amount exceeds type(uint160).max. src/libraries/Position.sol:94-97 computes fees owed with FullMath.mulDiv(..., liquidity, Q128), whose 512 bit branch (src/libraries/FullMath.sol:40-99) runs only when prod1, built from MULMOD at :25-28, is nonzero. A compiled-only fault in those branches would change the swap price, the amounts settled, or fees owed. Nothing in the code depends on which engine runs; the effect needs a client defect that no reading found.
verdicts.corrections: Minor: the main.cpp VM selection is at line 488 with the comment at 485-487, inside the cited 484-488 range. The "all 689 out-of-gas frames report out of gas" observation is supporting evidence only, since an out-of-gas frame that a compiled run reported as "error" would not be counted among them; the source reading is the proof. Actor operator is right: a mismatch would only reach canonical state if a supermajority of validators ran a faulty compiled build.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Step 2 planted fault: MULMOD(a, b, 2^256 - 1) off by one is caught only for even denominators.
clearedSpotChecks.note: src/libraries/FullMath.sol:59 gives twos = 1 for an odd denominator, :73 turns it into add(div(2^256-1, 1), 1) = 0, and :75 makes prod1 * twos zero, so prod1 drops out and the result is prod0 times the inverse, exact for an exact division whose quotient fits. prod1 still matters through require(denominator > prod1) at :30 and the prod1 == 0 shortcut at :33-38, which the item names. This is a limit on what the mined-swap battery can detect: odd liquidity denominators are common, so a high-word fault would mostly hide in mined data and the clearing correctly does not claim otherwise.
